envelope.description: Give the registry the services and add the daemon feedback and identity methods

body.title: Give the registry the services and add the daemon feedback and identity methods
body.summary: Extend the repository entry in src/daemon/lifecycle-registry.ts with a FeedbackService (and its History) and the IdentityService, and register artifact.feedback.add, artifact.feedback.list, identity.show and identity.declare in the handler map of src/daemon/index.ts, with the request actor handled by approvalActorOf and the current actor as the default. A repository that cannot get an entry is refused with that error.
acceptanceChecks: artifact.feedback.add stores an entry for the request's actor id, or the current actor when none is given, through the repository's FeedbackService
artifact.feedback.list returns threads, open ones when asked, for any artifact id including a Task
identity.show and identity.declare read and write the identity file through the service
an actor that is not a namespaced lower-case id is refused and nothing is recorded
a repository whose registry entry cannot be created is refused

tests.name: feedback-wiring.test.ts: the daemon's artifact.feedback.add, artifact.feedback.list, identity.show and identity.declare handlers use the repository's FeedbackService and the identity service
